observations: body L1, L3, L7, L11, L21: specks between «K.» and «Ginzel», between «usum» and «astronomorum», in the indent before «Ad», above «32m» and after «36m» are not transcribed.
body L9, L17, L20: the dashes of «221–22» and «ar–Raqqah» are long dashes (5.2 to 5.3 pt).
body L9-L16: the greatest difference between al-Battānī's and Ptolemy's mean time is 31m 12s or 32m 12s on p. 222; its half is the 16m added here.
body L19-L21: 36° 9′ and 39° 4′ at 4 minutes of time to the degree are 2h 24m 36s and 2h 36m 16s; Chesney's longitude of ar-Raqqah is 39° 3′ 57″ (p. 226, note 2).

body L23-L28: the true times of the syzygies are those of the computations: I. 1h 0m (p. 227); II. the 20h 20m of the observation at Antioch (p. 228) with the 50 minutes to the true conjunction (p. 229); III. 8h (p. 230); IV. 15h 20m (p. 231). The second column is 16m less al-Battānī's equation of days, 13m 4s (Leo 19°), 1m (Aquarius 8°), 12m 16s (Leo 4°) and 12m 40s (Leo 14° 36′); the fourth is the first plus the second less the third, for row I 22h 26m 40s after noon of 7 August, hence «7/8 Aug.». The last column is the fourth less the fifth in rows I–III; in row IV 12h 58m 44s − 12h 31m 18s is 27m 26s, where the print has 17m 26s, the value that fits the quarter of an hour of L29.
body L23-L24: in the head the bar of «Oppol.–Ginzel» (3.1 pt) is transcribed as a dash; specks around «Eclipses» are not transcribed.
notes_left L2: the period after «mathem» did not print.
notes_left L4-L6: the hyphens of «663-747», «629-755» and «491-559» measure 3.1 pt; «1884» is followed by a semicolon and a period.
notes_right L1: the apostrophe of «Oppolzer‘sche» is printed turned; a speck stands over its last e.
notes_right L4: the period after «mathem» is small and raised, and a speck stands before «Classe».
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
